001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.rolling;
002
003import java.io.File;
004import java.net.URI;
005import java.nio.file.Path;
006import java.util.function.Consumer;
007import java.util.function.Supplier;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProviderRef;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.DefaultParameter;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.file.FileOutput;
018
019/**
020 * A {@link FileOutput} that rolls (renames the active file to a numbered archive and
021 * starts a fresh one) once it grows past {@code maxFileSize}, retaining at most
022 * {@code maxHistory} archives.
023 * <p>
024 * Deliberately size (not calendar/date) triggered and only supports a <code>%i</code>
025 * (rotation index) token in {@link #DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN} - see
026 * {@code doc/overview.html}'s "Rolling Files" section for why: reopen-on-external-signal
027 * (e.g. via <code>logrotate</code>) remains the recommended approach for anything beyond
028 * "keep a small/desktop app from filling its disk", and that simpler need does not
029 * benefit from Logback-style calendar based archive naming.
030 * <p>
031 * Registered under the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} URI scheme (see
032 * {@code RollingConfigurator}), e.g. {@code rolling:///var/log/app.log?maxFileSize=...}.
033 * Every property below lives under the same {@link LogProperties#OUTPUT_PREFIX} as
034 * {@link FileOutput} itself - {@code uri}/{@code fileName}/{@code append}/
035 * {@code prudent}/{@code bufferSize} all still apply and are passed straight through to
036 * the underlying {@link FileOutput} this wraps.
037 */
038public interface RollingFileOutput extends FileOutput {
039
040        /**
041         * URI scheme for rolling file outputs.
042         */
043        static final String ROLLING_SCHEME = "rolling";
044
045        /**
046         * Default max file size in bytes before a roll is triggered - 10MB, matching
047         * Logback/Spring Boot's own default.
048         */
049        static final int DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
050
051        /**
052         * Default number of archives to retain - 7, matching Logback/Spring Boot's own
053         * default.
054         */
055        static final int DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY = 7;
056
057        /**
058         * Default total archive size cap in bytes. {@code 0} means unlimited.
059         */
060        static final int DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP = 0;
061
062        /**
063         * Default for whether archive pruning ({@code maxHistory}/{@code totalSizeCap}) also
064         * runs once at {@link #start(LogConfig)}, not just after each roll.
065         */
066        static final boolean DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START = false;
067
068        /**
069         * Default {@code fileNamePattern} - the literal text appended directly after the
070         * active file's own path (unlike Logback, never containing the base file name itself)
071         * with <code>%i</code> substituted for the rotation index, e.g. <code>app.log</code>
072         * with this pattern archives to <code>app.log.1</code>, <code>app.log.2</code>, etc.
073         * A pattern ending in <code>.gz</code> gzip compresses archives on rotation.
074         */
075        static final String DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN = ".%i";
076
077        /**
078         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a URI reference - the entry point used
079         * by the {@value #ROLLING_SCHEME} scheme registration.
080         * @param ref uri reference, may have a query string of builder properties (same
081         * convention as {@link FileOutput#of(LogProviderRef)}).
082         * @return provider.
083         */
084        public static LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> of(LogProviderRef ref) {
085                return (name, config) -> provide(ref, name, config);
086        }
087
088        /**
089         * Creates a rolling file output provider from a lambda builder and uses the config
090         * properties from the returned log provider - mirrors
091         * {@link FileOutput#of(Consumer)}.
092         * @param consumer builder lambda.
093         * @return provider.
094         */
095        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(Consumer<RollingFileOutputBuilder> consumer) {
096                return (name, config) -> {
097                        var builder = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
098                        consumer.accept(builder);
099                        builder.fromProperties(config.properties());
100                        return builder.build().provide(name, config);
101                };
102        }
103
104        private static FileOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogConfig config) {
105                var b = new RollingFileOutputBuilder(name);
106                var uri = ref.uri();
107                var properties = config.properties();
108                LogProperties combined;
109                if (uri.getQuery() != null) {
110                        combined = LogProperties.of(uri, b.propertyPrefix(), properties, ref.keyOrNull());
111                        String s = uri.toString();
112                        int index = s.indexOf('?');
113                        uri = URI.create(s.substring(0, index));
114                }
115                else {
116                        combined = properties;
117                }
118                b.uri(uri);
119                b.fromProperties(combined);
120                return b.build().provide(name, config);
121        }
122
123        /**
124         * Creates a rolling file output provider.
125         * @param name name of output, not file name.
126         * @param uri file uri.
127         * @param fileName file name.
128         * @param maxFileSize max file size in bytes before a roll is triggered.
129         * @param maxHistory number of archives to retain.
130         * @param totalSizeCap total archive size cap in bytes; {@code <= 0} means unlimited.
131         * @param cleanHistoryOnStart whether pruning also runs once at start, not just after
132         * each roll.
133         * @param fileNamePattern archive naming pattern; must contain <code>%i</code> and
134         * must not contain <code>%d</code> (date based rotation is not supported).
135         * @return rolling file output provider.
136         */
137        @LogConfigurable(name = "RollingFileOutputBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX)
138        public static LogProvider<RollingFileOutput> of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable URI uri,
139                        @Nullable String fileName, @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE") Integer maxFileSize,
140                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_MAX_HISTORY") Integer maxHistory,
141                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_TOTAL_SIZE_CAP") Integer totalSizeCap,
142                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_CLEAN_HISTORY_ON_START") Boolean cleanHistoryOnStart,
143                        @DefaultParameter("DEFAULT_FILE_NAME_PATTERN") String fileNamePattern) {
144                var parsedPattern = RollingPolicy.ParsedPattern.parse(fileNamePattern);
145                File file;
146                if (fileName != null) {
147                        file = new File(fileName);
148                }
149                else if (uri != null) {
150                        file = new File(uri.getPath());
151                }
152                else {
153                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("fileName and uri cannot both be unset.");
154                }
155                Path activeFile = file.toPath().toAbsolutePath();
156                String fileNameForDelegate = file.getPath();
157                int maxFileSize_ = maxFileSize;
158                int maxHistory_ = maxHistory;
159                int totalSizeCap_ = totalSizeCap;
160                boolean cleanHistoryOnStart_ = cleanHistoryOnStart;
161                return (n, config) -> {
162                        Supplier<FileOutput> supplier = () -> FileOutput.of(fb -> fb.fileName(fileNameForDelegate).append(true))
163                                .provide(n, config);
164                        return new DefaultRollingFileOutput(activeFile, parsedPattern, maxFileSize_, maxHistory_, totalSizeCap_,
165                                        cleanHistoryOnStart_, supplier);
166                };
167        }
168
169}
